Name: Music Everywhere (Play Your Own OGG Music)
Author: Nelnix
Description:
[center][color=#d4d4d8][size=6][b]Music Everywhere[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley has many silent areas and quiet moments throughout the day. Music Everywhere fills those moments with your own custom OGG music, creating a more immersive and personalized experience without replacing the game's original soundtrack.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[left][list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Supports custom .ogg music files.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Automatically detects new music files.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Generates a separate configuration file for every song automatically.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply drop your music into the folder no manual setup required.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No limit on the number of custom tracks.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Configure the start time, end time, and volume for each song individually.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/left]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Installation & Getting Started[/size][/b][/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip Music Everywhere.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Place your .ogg music files into the mod's music folder.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Launch the game once. The mod will automatically detect your music and create a configuration file for each track.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Only requires SMAPI.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No known compatibility issues at this time.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you discover any conflicts with other mods, please report them so I can investigate and fix the issue.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Multiplayer compatibility has not been tested yet.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Android compatibility has not been tested yet.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mod Developer: Nelnix[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]AI was used during development to assist with debugging and speed up the development process.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod description was also written with the assistance of AI. (90% xD)[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
